Applications for the Hebei Normal University CSC Scholarship are now open. The Chinese Government Scholarship—Chinese University Program is fully funded and aims to attract international students to undertake studies at the Hebei Normal University, China.

The program has been established to enhance mutual understanding and friendship between the Chinese people and the people of other countries and to develop exchanges and cooperation between China and other countries in various fields. The Chinese government scholarship aims to assist outstanding students, teachers and scholars from all over the world to study or carry out research in Chinese universities in areas related to science, engineering & technology, agriculture, medicine, economics, law, management, education, history, liberal arts, philosophy, etc.

Founded in 1902, Hebei Normal University (河北师范大学) is a public research university in China. The institution has a vast library, diverse academic programs, and renowned faculties. The university hosts over 28,000 students and fosters international collaboration through partnerships with institutions in over 23 countries. From Confucius Institutes to research centers, Hebei Normal University actively bridges cultures and welcomes international students to pursue their academic journeys within its vibrant community. The university is among the designated Chinese universities that can host Chinese Government Scholarship selectees.

Program Details
Host Institution: Hebei Normal University in China.
Eligible Program: Available master’s and PhD programs at Hebei Normal University.
Number of Awards: Not specified.
Duration: Up to 3 years for the master’s degree program and up to 4 years for PhD degree program.
Target group: Open to all nationalities (except Chinese citizens).

Selected candidates for the CSC Chinese University Program to study in Asia will be provided with the following benefits:

Exempt from registration, tuition, laboratory experiment, internship and on-campus accommodation fees;
Monthly Living Allowance:
Undergraduates and advanced students for Chinese program : 2 500 RMB/month;
Master’s degree students: 3 000 RMB/month;
PhD degree students: 3 500 RMB/month.
Comprehensive Medical Insurance for International Students in China.

Hebei Normal University CSC Scholarship Eligibility
To apply for the Chinese Government Scholarship at Hebei Normal University, applicants must meet the following requirements:

Be a non-Chinese citizen.
Be in good health.
Educational background and age limit:
Applicants for Bachelor’s degree programs must have a high school diploma, excellent academic results, and be under 25
Applicants for the master’s degree program must have bachelor’s degree and be under 35
Applicants for doctoral degree programs must have a master’s degree and be under 40
Applicants for the advanced Chinese program must have a high school diploma and be under 35
Applicants for the junior advanced program must have studied in university as sophomores and be under 45
Applicants for the senior advanced program must have a master’s degree or be associate professors or above and be under 50.
How to Apply for the CSC Scholarship at Hebei Normal University
Eligible candidates who would like to apply for this government scholarship program at Hebei Normal University must follow the steps below:

 The program category should be Type B, and the Agency No. of Hebei Normal University is 10094. Upload the required documents and click on SUBMIT. Also check the FAQ About Chinese Government Scholarship for more info about CSC scholarships.
Visit the online application system of Hebei Normal University and follow the given instructions to submit your application.
Required Documents
Applicants should provide the following documents truthfully, correctly, and completely.

Application Form for Chinese Government Scholarship (filled in Chinese or English and obtained above).
Highest academic diploma (notarized photocopy). If applicants are university students, they must also provide proof of study offered by the university.
Academic transcripts. Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized translations in Chinese or English.
Study or research plan. Applicants for master’s or doctoral programs, or senior advanced programs, must submit a study or research plan in Chinese or English.
Recommendation letters. Applicants for master’s or doctoral programs, or senior advanced programs, must submit two recommendation letters in Chinese or English by professors or associate professors.
Applicants in China must submit an admission notice or offer from the university they are applying to.
Applicants for music studies are requested to submit a CD of their own works. Applicants for fine arts must submit a DVD of their own works (two sketches, two color paintings, and two other works).
Applicants under 18 must submit the relevant legal documents of their legal guardians in China.
Photocopy of Foreigner Physical Examination Form.
Note: Uploaded supporting documents must be clear, authentic, and valid. Applicants are recommended to use a professional device to scan the relevant documents. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized translations into Chinese or English.

The deadline to submit applications for this Chinese scholarship program is April 30, 2026. For more details on the Hebei Normal University CSC Scholarship, please read the CSC Scholarship Application Tips and Tricks and visit the official page.
